text_en: The word of the Lord that came to Joel son of Pethuel:
text_cn: 上主的话传给培突耳的儿子岳厄尔：

text_en: Hear this, O elders, give ear, all inhabitants of the land! Has such a thing happened in your days, or in the days of your ancestors?
text_cn: 老人们，你们应听这事！地上的一切居民，你们应侧耳细听！在你们的时日，或在你们祖先的时日，是否曾有过这样的事？

text_en: Tell your children of it, and let your children tell their children, and their children another generation.
text_cn: 你们应将这事告诉你们的子孙；你们的子孙应传给他们的子孙；他们的子孙又应传给下一代：

text_en: What the cutting locust left, the swarming locust has eaten. What the swarming locust left, the hopping locust has eaten, and what the hopping locust left, the destroying locust has eaten.
text_cn: 蝻（nǎn）子吃剩的，飞蝗来吃了；飞蝗吃剩的，螽（zhōng）斯来吃了；螽斯吃剩的，蚱蜢来吃了。

text_en: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep; and wail, all you wine-drinkers, over the sweet wine, for it is cut off from your mouth.
text_cn: 醉汉，你们醒来恸（tòng）哭罢！一切爱喝酒的人，为了新酒悲泣吧！因为已由你们嘴边夺去了。

text_en: For a nation has invaded my land, powerful and innumerable; its teeth are lions’ teeth, and it has the fangs of a lioness.
text_cn: 因为有一个民族侵入了我的地域，既强大而又不可胜数；他们的牙有如狮子的牙，臼齿有如母狮的臼齿。

text_en: It has laid waste my vines, and splintered my fig trees; it has stripped off their bark and thrown it down; their branches have turned white.
text_cn: 他们蹂躏了我的葡萄园，折断了我的无花果树，将树皮完全剥掉，使树枝光秃发白。

text_en: Lament like a virgin dressed in sackcloth for the husband of her youth.
text_cn: 你哀伤吧！如同一个身披丧服的处女，哀哭她青年的未婚夫。

text_en: The grain offering and the drink offering are cut off from the house of the Lord . The priests mourn, the ministers of the Lord .
text_cn: 上主殿中的素祭和奠祭已中断；上主的仆人──司祭都悲哀不已。

text_en: The fields are devastated, the ground mourns; for the grain is destroyed, the wine dries up, the oil fails.
text_cn: 田园已荒废，土地已凄凉；因为五谷已遭蹂躏，美酒已枯竭，油已干涸。

text_en: Be dismayed, you farmers, wail, you vinedressers, over the wheat and the barley; for the crops of the field are ruined.
text_cn: 农夫，你们应哀哭！葡萄园丁，你们应为了小麦和大麦而号咷（táo）！因为田园的出产已遭破坏。

text_en: The vine withers, the fig tree droops. Pomegranate, palm, and apple— all the trees of the field are dried up; surely, joy withers away among the people.
text_cn: 葡萄树枯槁了，无花果树凋谢了；石榴树、棕树、苹果树，以及田间的一切果树都枯死了；为此喜乐已由人间消失。

text_en: Put on sackcloth and lament, you priests; wail, you ministers of the altar. Come, pass the night in sackcloth, you ministers of my God! Grain offering and drink offering are withheld from the house of your God.
text_cn: 司祭，你们应披上麻衣而哀悼！服务祭坛的人，你们应号咷！我天主的仆人，你们应进来，披上麻衣过夜！因为素祭和奠祭在你们天主的殿内已中断了。

text_en: Sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly. Gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land to the house of the Lord your God, and cry out to the Lord .
text_cn: 你们应制定一个斋期，召开一个盛会，聚集长老和当地的一切居民，在上主你们天主的殿内，向上主呼号。

text_en: Alas for the day! For the day of the Lord is near, and as destruction from the Almighty it comes.
text_cn: 啊，那日子啊！上主的日子来近了，它来有如全能者施行毁灭。

text_en: Is not the food cut off before our eyes, joy and gladness from the house of our God?
text_cn: 食物不是在我们眼前断绝了吗？喜乐和欢欣不是离开了我们天主的殿吗？

text_en: The seed shrivels under the clods, the storehouses are desolate; the granaries are ruined because the grain has failed.
text_cn: 麦粒已在土块下腐烂，粮仓业已荒废，廪房业已坍塌，因为五谷都枯死了。

text_en: How the animals groan! The herds of cattle wander about because there is no pasture for them; even the flocks of sheep are dazed.
text_cn: 牲畜为什么悲鸣？牛群为什么徬徨？因为没有了草场；连羊群也感绝望。

text_en: To you, O Lord , I cry. For fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and flames have burned all the trees of the field.
text_cn: 上主，我向你呼号，因为烈火吞灭了原野的牧场，火焰焚烧了田间的一切树木。

text_en: Even the wild animals cry to you because the watercourses are dried up, and fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
text_cn: 连野兽也向你恳切哀鸣，因为水流已枯竭，烈火又吞灭了原野的牧场。
